Game Overview

Lara is a platformer title where guide Lara through a mesmerizing world of the dead, where every step challenges your wits and bravery. Solve devious puzzles and engage with spectral beings amid shadowy landscapes. Unravel secrets, dodge perilous traps, and make spine-chilling choices in this unforgettable quest to bring Lara back to life.
